They possess a distinct smell. When [[Link]] receives his first Seed, he is asked to return it to the Korok [[Hestu]]. Korok Seeds are actually the beads used in [[Hestu's Maracas]]. When first found, Hestu asks Link to retrieve his Maracas from a group of [[Bokoblin]]s nearby. After Link returns them, Hestu realizes the Seeds were taken by the other Koroks as part of a prank. In exchange for Korok Seeds, Hestu will add one slot to Link's [[Weapon]], [[Bow]]s, or [[Shield]]s stashes. Link can fully upgrade his inventory with only 441 Korok Seeds. If all 900 Seeds are returned to Hestu, he will reward Link with a "[[Hestu's Gift|gift of friendship]]". ====Inventory Slots and Upgrade Costs==== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !style="width:20%"| Inventory Slot !style="width:20%"| Weapons !style="width:20%"| Bows !style="width:20%"| Shields |- | 1st | [[Master Sword]]{{List Note|This inventory slot is automatically received upon obtaining the Master Sword.}} | Base | Base |- | 2nd | Base | Base | Base |- | 3rd | Base | Base | Base |- | 4th | Base | Base | Base |- | 5th | Base | Base | 1 |- | 6th | Base | 1 | 2 |- | 7th | Base | 2 | 3 |- | 8th | Base | 3 | 4 |- | 9th | Base | 5 | 5 |- | 10th | 1 | 8 | 10 |- | 11th | 2 | 12 | 10 |- | 12th | 3 | 17 | 10 |- | 13th | 5 | 25 | 10 |- | 14th | 8 | [[Arrow]]s | 10 |- | 15th | 12 | [[Fire Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 16th | 17 | [[Ice Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 17th | 25 | [[Shock Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 18th | 35 | [[Bomb Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 19th | 45 | [[Ancient Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 20th | 55 | [[Bow of Light]]{{List Note|This inventory slot is automatically received upon obtaining the Bow of Light during the [[Dark Beast Ganon]] fight, and cannot be unlocked permanently.}} | 20 |- ! Total ! 208 ! 73 ! 160 |} {{List Notes}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Korok Seeds return in {{TotK}}, once again given by Koroks after solving a [[Korok Seed Puzzle]]. There are still 900 Korok Seed Puzzles, however with the addition of the [[Traveling Korok Duo]] puzzles rewarding two Korok Seeds on completion, there are now 1,000 total Korok Seeds to collect throughout the [[Sky Island]]s and [[Surface]]. They can again be given to [[Hestu]] in exchange for [[Inventory]] expansions. The amount of Korok Seeds required to fully upgrade [[Link]]'s Inventory has been reduced to 421. After returning all 1,000 Korok Seeds to Hestu, he will reward Link with [[Hestu's Gift]]. ====Inventory Slots and Upgrade Costs==== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !style="width:20%"| Inventory Slot !style="width:20%"| Weapons !style="width:20%"| Bows !style="width:20%"| Shields |- | 1st | [[Master Sword]]{{List Note|This inventory slot is automatically received upon obtaining the Master Sword.}} | Base | Base |- | 2nd | Base | Base | Base |- | 3rd | Base | Base | Base |- | 4th | Base | Base | Base |- | 5th | Base | Base | 1 |- | 6th | Base | 1 | 2 |- | 7th | Base | 2 | 3 |- | 8th | Base | 3 | 4 |- | 9th | Base | 5 | 5 |- | 10th | Base | 8 | 10 |- | 11th | 1 | 12 | 10 |- | 12th | 2 | 17 | 10 |- | 13th | 3 | 25 | 10 |- | 14th | 5 | 35 | 10 |- | 15th | 8 | [[Arrow]]s | 15 |- | 16th | 12 | - | 15 |- | 17th | 17 | - | 15 |- | 18th | 25 | - | 15 |- | 19th | 35 | - | 15 |- | 20th | 45 | - | 20 |- ! Total ! 153 ! 108 ! 160 |} {{List Notes}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Korok Seeds can be obtained in [[Scenario]]s and certain [[Challenge]]s by uncovering hidden [[Korok]]s. They can also be received as rewards for completing [[Quest]]s centered around [[Hestu]]'s involvement. Once a [[Warrior]] locates a Korok, it will give them a Korok Seed. Koroks that Warriors find will remain out in the open as the [[Battle]] progresses. There is a total of 175 Korok Seeds to find in {{AoC}}, and are divided as such: *122 Korok Seeds are hidden within the 20 Scenarios. *12 Korok Seeds are hidden with 11 specific Challenges. *41 Korok Seeds are obtained as rewards, which are further divided: **26 of these Korok Seeds are obtained as part of the First Clear Rewards for completing specific Challenges. **15 Korok Seeds are obtained by completing the Quest "[[Helping with Heights]]". Once Hestu is unlocked as a [[Warrior]], the Warriors will be able to complete Quests that increase [[Inventory]] space. These Quests, found under the Battle Support tab, have [[Hestu's Maracas]] as their icons. After completing the Quest "[[A Most Peculiar Korok]]", Korok Seeds can be seen on the [[Battle Info]] screen of applicable Scenarios. Collected Korok Seeds are colored in white, while uncollected Korok Seeds are left dark gray. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Descriptions AoI}} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Trivia== * [[Hidemaro Fujibayashi]], director of {{BotW|-}}, confirmed that Korok Seeds are in fact [[Korok]] feces. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:TotK Korok Seed Map Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Korok Seed shown on the Map File:TotK Korok Seed x2 Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Korok Seed x2 shown on the Map File:TotK Inventory Upgrades Cost Reference.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A resource graphic depicting the inventory upgrade costs File:AoC Korok Seed Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of a Korok Seed ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hestu's Gift * Secret Seashell }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Korok Seed}}
